title: Describe the accounting treatment for changes in inventory methods

items.concept: Retrospective inventory-method change (LIFO to FIFO) — opening Inventory/RE adjusting JE; subsequent inventory–income reconciliation schedule; restated comparative NI and inventory
Number-variant twin — retrospective change from average cost to FIFO; opening Inventory/RE JE; multi-year ΔInv = cum ΔNI schedule; restated comparatives
Prospective application when changing to LIFO (impracticable to reconstruct layers); no opening JE; base-layer subsequent schedule; mixed-method comparative presentation
Classification of equity effect from the January 1 retrospective Inventory/RE entry (LIFO → FIFO)
Method classification — when inventory-method changes are retrospective vs prospective
